content:
Interesting.
Correction: Shobu was designed by Manolis Vranas and Jamie Sajdak of Seesaw Games

Below are some preliminary comments.

* The standard "Victory Conditions" and "Defeat Conditions" sections are missing.

* Please change the heading "Game Input" to "Game Input/Output".

* Please format all line numbers using the tag <span class="statement-lineno">.

* (Optional) Consider including a link to the referee code.

Thanks.

P.S. I'll also conduct a more detailed review of the statement and some play-testing within the next day or two.

Nice: the rules match the original game, and I couldn't break the referee. I checked the move generator against an independent implementation (same legal moves, pushes and wins on 40,000 positions from random games) and played the longest case (swap in both rounds, 2 x 110 moves) without any SDK error. 

A few minor suggestions:

- The default stub output is an illegal move. 3 7 3 3 0 -1 makes both moves on dark boards ((3,7) and (3,3) are both on dark boards). 3 7 4 3 0 -1 is legal for black's first move. A comment telling players to print one of the given legal moves would help too.

- The statement doesn't say that a timeout or an invalid action loses the whole match, including a round already won. The referee does this (score -1), so one sentence in the "Match" section would make it clear.

- The bosses won't compile with newer GCC versions. CodinGame currently uses GCC 11.2, where they compile fine. With GCC 13, #pragma GCC target("popcnt") placed before the #includes fails with "inlining failed in call to 'always_inline' … target specific option mismatch", and all three Boss.cpp files fail to build. A compiler upgrade on CG would break the leagues. Putting the pragma after the standard #includes (or dropping it) fixes this; I checked that it builds with GCC 13.

(This comment was generated using the recently updated CG API :D)
updated with some polish, improved statement, timeline markers, might be ready to leave WIP soon

A turn: two moves
* "Only turns whose aggressive move is legal are legal": Consider rewriting the statement as:
A turn is legal only when both of its moves are legal.

End of a round / Pie rule / Console message
* Please replace all instances of "move(s)" with "turn(s)" when referring to the 110-turn limit.

Victory Conditions
* Please replace "legal move" with "legal turn".

Output
* Please add "for one game turn" to the section heading.

Input / Stub / Viewer / Console message
* The viewer and the console messages use the descriptions "Round 1" and "Round 2", whereas the Input section and the stub indicate that the variable "round" takes the values 0 or 1. Please make them consistent.

Input / Constraints / Stub
* Consider renaming the variable "moveCount" to "turnCount".

Stub
* Consider renaming the variable "lastMove" to "lastTurn" and updating the comment accordingly.

* Consider changing "legal move(s)" in the comments to "legal turn(s)".

Cover picture
* Please upload a cover picture for the puzzle.

Thanks.
Thanks for the feedback. I've updated some phrasing (action vs move vs turn) since an action can be SWAP or 2 "moves" (passive and aggressive) in a single turn.

Thanks for the update. I agree that using "action" is clearer.

Two small points after another look:

Input
* Line 1: I'd suggest omitting "home boards at the bottom" for simplicity, since there's no corresponding description for white.

Viewer
* Custom output messages: Anything longer than roughly 25 characters extends beyond the player's box.
